raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "58f604a46cda44b68ca7a6f4f74dca34::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Use the name property for the term being defined"}, {"item_id": "b66f2c482efe41ba841715ad8d5c2272::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "use termCode if the term has an alpha-numeric code allocated"}, {"item_id": "204e8631811a48e3b60aecbc62e0b347::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "use description to provide the definition of the term"}, {"item_id": "932a50e55b4c4fbcb5c1e0007ed11ecf::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Use the about property to specify what the term is about."}, {"item_id": "ab058388101c489f86936ffbb15d4607::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is one of the automation requirements SDMX supports."}, {"item_id": "ab058388101c489f86936ffbb15d4607::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is transforming data and metadata into application-specific, standard and presentational formats."}, {"item_id": "e423b4bd3c2845238a38be9f6e12d84e::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is a very broad term in the document."}, {"item_id": "e423b4bd3c2845238a38be9f6e12d84e::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is subdivided into structural and reference metadata."}, {"item_id": "353adde46b6248b28a4717e260c6133b::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "It is the multi-dimensional co-ordinate system."}, {"item_id": "353adde46b6248b28a4717e260c6133b::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Its named dimensions are formed by metadata values and concepts describing statistical data."}, {"item_id": "848d05c2a02f40ee830da886d7f20c42::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Concepts used in the description and identification of statistical data and metadata."}]}
